letter.title: A letter from the AionUi team
letter.whyLead: The old "ship an installer, run it on your own" model could not support the experience we want to deliver:
letter.whyReason1: Once an installer shipped, we could no longer reach it — fixes could not arrive in time, and the latest skills and assistants could not be synced to you;
letter.whyReason2: Maintaining reliable installers for Mac and Windows carries ongoing signing, certification, and security investment;
letter.whyReason3: Long-awaited capabilities — multiple accounts, data sync, safer mobile companion — all need a more secure, professional service foundation.
letter.promise2: Your local data stays as it is: after your first sign-in, the new version inherits your current conversations, settings, and API keys in place — nothing to reconfigure. This is a one-time migration: once it completes, the new version holds that data and the current version is no longer its entry point;
letter.promise3: No spending is tied to the new version: the way you use AionUi today is the way you will use it tomorrow, and everything free today stays free;
letter.choicesTitle: You are still free to choose:
letter.choice2: If you prefer local DIY, keep pulling the open-source code and package it yourself.
letter.closing: Finally, thank you for walking this far with AionUi — we look forward to meeting you in the new version.
letter.whyOutroBold: the new version requires sign-in to use
letter.whyOutroSuffix: (Google sign-in is supported, with more options on the way). We want to build AionUi as a real product for the long run — with accounts, these finally have a starting point, and we can respond to your reports far better.
letter.choice1Bold: If you use AionUi day to day, we recommend upgrading to the new version
letter.choice1Rest: : new capabilities, skills, and assistants will reach you first, and upcoming account-based services like data sync will open up seamlessly;
letter.promise1Bold: Your conversations and files stay local
letter.promise1Rest: : agents run on your own computer, and your conversations and files are never uploaded to our servers;
letter.introPrefix: Thank you for your continued support of AionUi.
letter.introBold: This is an invitation to download the new version of AionUi
letter.introSuffix: : from now on, installers and updates will be provided through our official website instead of GitHub Releases, and we sincerely invite you to get the new version there.
letter.promise4: The open-source repository stays actively maintained, core features stay in sync, and the open-source spirit remains.
letter.noRush: If you would rather wait, the current version keeps working as usual — it simply no longer receives updates. And once you have completed the first sign-in on the new version, your local data has already moved there, so please use the new version as your day-to-day entry point.

warmAcp.title: Warm ACP Session & 3.1s Team Turn Response
warmAcp.item1: Persistent JSON-RPC 2.0 WarmAcpClient keeps Antigravity sessions alive across turns (zero cold restarts, 88.6% KV-cache hit rate).
warmAcp.item2: Team slots strip unused global customizations (--include-default-customizations=false) to cut startup latency.
warmAcp.item3: Live In / Cache / Out token counters and KV-Cache % badge inside the Team Context Compact popover.

teamToken.title: 1-Shot Atomic Task Board & Wake Coalescing
teamToken.item1: Eliminated phantom idle Lead wakes and added 1.5s / 4.5s parallel teammate wake coalescing.
teamToken.item2: 1-shot atomic team_task_update (reply_message + reply_files), create-batch, 8-char short task IDs, and TaskBoardDigestCursor (-85.4% board payload).
teamToken.item3: Durable SQLite handover and post-compaction role_prompt retention across 3-tier 160K smart context compaction.

hybridHub.title: Shared Rooms, Isolated Git Worktrees & Action Inbox
hybridHub.item1: Multi-team Shared Rooms default to Chair-only routing (saving 50-67% fan-out tokens) with @all broadcast and hop profiler.
hybridHub.item2: Isolated Git Worktrees with 1-click Squash Merge and strict Human-Only Done task guard.
hybridHub.item3: 2-way Action Inbox synced with Telegram inline buttons via atomic single-use decision locks.

walletI18n.title: Dual Cost Wallet ($0 CLI Immunity) & 14-Locale Polish
walletI18n.item1: OAuth CLI subscriptions (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity) stay $0.00 and immune to paid API circuit breakers, with 1-click Quota Presets.
walletI18n.item2: Pre-seeded instant model switching across New Chat, Conversation Header, and Team slots.
walletI18n.item3: Clean en-US default boot, full 14-locale Unicode NFC parity, and Telex/VNI IME composition protection.
